name: Proper Stable Labeled Sample Compression of the Three-Code Class
proof: The explicit code table in $\texttt{sync/verify\_properness\_separation.py}$ assigns every realizable partial sample a labeled subsample of size at most one. Its decoder always belongs to $\mathcal C_{\triangle}$, is sample-consistent, and the table directly checks stability under deletion of every unselected example. Size zero is impossible for a non-singleton class.
